crafts.name: Plant Pot
instructions: Use scissors to carefully cut open the lid of the can
Paint and decorate the can if desired
Pour a thin layer of pebbles into the bottom of the can for drainage
Pour a thick layer of soil into the can
Place your seed or plant into the soil
crafts.sustainability_note: The tin can is repurposed into a durable and stylish plant pot.
environmental_benefits: Creates a small indoor air-purifying plant space

crafts.name: Stationery Holder
instructions: Carefully cut the lid off the can
Paint the outside of the can and decorate it
crafts.sustainability_note: The sturdy tin can becomes an easy-to-use portable stationery holder while providing a stylish storage solution.
environmental_benefits: Prevents accumulation in landfills and reduces environmental harm

crafts.name: Storage Container
materials: Tin Can (preferably one with a lid)
instructions: Wash and dry the can to remove any residue
Paint the outside of the can
Fill it with desired items such as candy, coffee beans, or other small objects
crafts.sustainability_note: The tin can is repurposed into a durable reusable storage container.
environmental_benefits: Creates a DIY project that benefits the environment
